follow-up time: Through pregnancy until delivery (20 December 2021 to 31 August 2022)
exposure: Third dose (first booster dose) of COVID-19 vaccine during pregnancy (among individuals who completed primary COVID-19 vaccine series before pregnancy)
completion of two doses of primary covid-19 messenger RNA vaccine series before pregnancy
third dose of covid-19 vaccine during pregnancy
outcome: Admission to neonatal intensive care unit for >24 h
cohort: 32,689 births in Ontario, Canada, from 20 December 2021 to 31 August 2022; 18,491 (56.6%) born to individuals who received a third COVID-19 vaccine dose during pregnancy
finding: Receipt of a third COVID-19 vaccine dose during pregnancy was not associated with an increased risk of adverse pregnancy, fetal, or neonatal outcomes.
mod_finding: Receipt of a third covid-19 vaccine dose during pregnancy was not associated with an increased risk of cesarean delivery.
